objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, versioned, archived, translated, invalidated and reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Includes document type abbreviation, consecutive four-digit number per type across clients, and title by default.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default and not language-independent.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive four-digit number per document type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version metadata that can be printed in the document and is retained or updated through versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle status displayed and printable in the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link the document to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader User Groups.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the registered author.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights; co-authors have no relevance within the release workflow.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Attribute used for release including translation.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version required to be in the Released state before translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document validity period is calculated.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a validity check is necessary, definable for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration after which archived documents are physically deleted, definable for each document type.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating new document objects; templates and validity/archive periods can be defined per type.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Names are suggestions and may vary from company to company.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation for document naming.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary per document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive period defined per document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template that can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover that can be created so external files or documents can be uploaded to it or new documents generated from standard MS Office formats.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file or document that can be uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted representation generated automatically after a document is saved and displayed on the web.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, recipient, or workflow task editor.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role or license role assigned to a user.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language used to determine visibility of released language versions.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users assigned for authorizations, reader access, distribution, archive access, or role-specific selection lists.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Group name such as Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, releaser, Archive, or Business Admin group.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to User Groups or persons for documents.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document added to a document, automatically released with the main document, versioned, and archived with a later main document release.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting the content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation, or acknowledgement processes.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete release tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent by the system to involved users about workflow tasks, document release, change proposals, acknowledgements, and validity or override information.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document that must be processed with workflow support before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created for a selected document to invalidate and archive released documents with no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document; only the Business Admin group is permitted to create it.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document by assigning User Groups or persons for distribution by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_by_e_mail
attributes.description: Distribution type whose assigned users receive e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Distribution type whose assigned users are requested to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement requested from persons and users of assigned User Groups upon document release.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard listing documents relevant to a user based on distribution group assignment.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation or search report for documents, instructions, workflow status, or acknowledgements.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: local_document
objs.description: New document created in a client to describe a local addition, change, or extension and reference the original document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a template defined for the document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploading external files or generating new documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate a new document based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the document content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current converted version as a PDF on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in the Control category.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, or translation participants in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add Additional Info to a document when attaching a new information object to the document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish Additional Info directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete Additional Info directly because it lacks criticality.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document when attaching a new information object to the document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, which triggers a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: Mark a released Attachment for archiving.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an Attachment with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: initiate_release_process
evts.description: Start the three-step release process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes release task positively to finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reject during review or release, cancelling the workflow for all subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so that it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid and released document is revised or when specified triggers occur.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, retaining previous version data while allowing adaptation.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change Proposal for a document without affecting document content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change Proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned Change Proposals directly in the Change Proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change Proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the Valid Until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, deleting the request and updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a revised version is released or override is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: User with write access creates a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: Process the request for override through one of the available workflow processes.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Declare documents and attachments invalid and archive them by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: Process the reactivation workflow by the request creator as editor of the workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Reactivate invalidated document by creating a new version, retaining metadata and properties, setting authorizations, confirming distribution list entries, and reactivating archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups or persons in a document distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by e-mail from persons and users of User Groups entered for acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement in a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify the author team as soon as all persons maintained in the Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards with information based on distribution groups per document.

evts.name: list_document
evts.description: List all documents relevant to the user in the Document list dashboard.

evts.name: display_document_detail
evts.description: Display detailed information such as Attachments, Additional Info, referenced documents and language versions when a document is selected.

evts.name: run_report
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports or searches using selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated version with workflow support so it is visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to describe a local addition, change, or extension.

evts.name: reference_original_document
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.
